description: One-output TR8x4(P2) rotary mechanism with selectable Surpass Hobby 2845 or 2838 motors, hub-pinned 1:1 gears, a widened nut with ±20 degree carrier-wall stops and four SMB MF106 2Z bearings. Screws fasten only the motor and the enlarged output head.
releaseRequirements: Cut the two-start TR8x4 thread in an unthreaded blank, leaving intact 6 mm journals; do not turn 6 mm journals from a 5.5 mm thread root.
Assign fits, material, runout, coaxiality, lubrication and permissible axial/radial loads on component drawings.

Match-drill only the separate gear hubs and shafts for the recessed spring cross-pins: diameter 2 on the screw and diameter 1 on the motor. The pin holes must remain outside the tooth faces. Support shafts and control debris and installation force.
Finish the nut end-stop faces and carrier walls so contact corresponds to -20 and +20 degrees; retain the bearing-clearance pockets and qualify stop loads and control limits.

Use DIN 6799-3.2 E-Clips on short 5 mm necks immediately outside the 6 mm bearing journals. Cut 3.2 mm root grooves 0.64 mm wide directly at the bearing edges, with no intervening shims. Confirm retention strength, end float and clearance from stationary races.
Confirm motor screw insertion depth, phase-lead routing and reversible sensorless low-speed operation on the purchased motor.
Laser-cut the two fork plates, finish the round bores and match-drill the transverse edge/shaft holes for the spring pins.
Qualify fork-slot wear, cross-pin fatigue, retaining grooves and the custom ST3215-pattern M3 output head for the intended duty.
